comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: The current guard needs an explicit `o === null` check: `typeof null` is `"object"`, so the existing `typeof o !== "object" || Array.isArray(o)` condition lets the parsed `null` through. Adding `o === null` there rejects both the JSON text `null` and the string value `"null"` while preserving object inputs. A regression case for `tryToParseObject("null")` would cover it.
